title: Participación en el Congreso ECER 2026
excerpt: Varios miembros del IUCE han participado en la European Conference on Educational Research (ECER) 2026, celebrada del 17 al 21 de agosto en Tampere (Finlandia).
content:
Varios miembros del Instituto Universitario de Ciencias de la Educación (IUCE) de la Universidad de Salamanca han participado en la European Conference on Educational Research (ECER) 2026, celebrada del 17 al 21 de agosto en Tampere (Finlandia).

Organizado por la European Educational Research Association (EERA), ECER es uno de los principales congresos europeos de investigación educativa y reúne anualmente a investigadores de diferentes países para compartir sus investigaciones.

En esta edición, bajo el lema «Knowing and Acting: The changing conditions and potentials of education research», se presentaron dos contribuciones enmarcadas en los Proyectos Nacionales QUALITY y ONSIDE:

  • «Knowing and Acting on Student-Centered Learning: Evidence-Informed Quality Enhancement through Indicators of Student Agency», realizada por Marina García-Herrero, Alberto Ortiz-López, Susana Olmos-Migueláñez, María-José Rodríguez-Conde y Celia Rodríguez Lozano.
  • «The EQGED Index: Quantifying the Differential Impact of Socioeconomic Status on Math Achievement by Gender in Europe», realizada por Elena Sáez-González, Adriana Gamazo, José Carlos Sánchez-Prieto y Susana Olmos-Migueláñez.

La participación en ECER 2026 adquiere además un significado especial de cara a ECER 2028, que tendrá lugar en Salamanca, entre los días 21 y 25 de agosto de 2028.
excerptEn: Several IUCE members took part in the European Conference on Educational Research (ECER) 2026, held from 17 to 21 August in Tampere (Finland).
contentEn:
Several members of the University Institute of Education Sciences (IUCE) of the University of Salamanca took part in the European Conference on Educational Research (ECER) 2026, held from 17 to 21 August in Tampere (Finland).

Organised by the European Educational Research Association (EERA), ECER is one of the leading European conferences on educational research, bringing together researchers from different countries every year to share their work.

At this edition, under the theme «Knowing and Acting: The changing conditions and potentials of education research», two contributions were presented within the national projects QUALITY and ONSIDE:

  • «Knowing and Acting on Student-Centered Learning: Evidence-Informed Quality Enhancement through Indicators of Student Agency», by Marina García-Herrero, Alberto Ortiz-López, Susana Olmos-Migueláñez, María-José Rodríguez-Conde and Celia Rodríguez Lozano.
  • «The EQGED Index: Quantifying the Differential Impact of Socioeconomic Status on Math Achievement by Gender in Europe», by Elena Sáez-González, Adriana Gamazo, José Carlos Sánchez-Prieto and Susana Olmos-Migueláñez.

Taking part in ECER 2026 also carries a special significance looking ahead to ECER 2028, which will be held in Salamanca from 21 to 25 August 2028.
